title: Stronger preference of human tumor suppressor protein BRCA1 for an open-planar Holliday junction: Insights from a combined spectroscopic and computational study.
authors: Kabir, Sahil Hasan; K, Vishnupriya; Pal, Nibedita
one_liner_zh: 结合单分子光谱、分子对接与全原子MD模拟，研究BRCA1蛋白对Holliday连接体开放平面构象的偏好及关键残基互作机制，属广义蛋白-DNA互作且方法可迁移至TF-DNA体系。
abstract: BRCA1 is a complex tumor suppressor protein involved in multiple critical cellular processes, e.g., DNA double-strand break repair, cell cycle checkpoint, etc. BRCA1-depleted cells show decreased homologous recombination (HR) and promote error-prone non-homologous end joining for DNA damage repair. Holliday junction (HJ) is an essential intermediate of DNA damage repair mechanism through HR. BRCA1 protein has high affinity for HJ and recruits several proteins to DNA damage site. Nonetheless, questions remain regarding the binding of BRCA1 protein with HJ. Does BRCA1 protein show preference for isomers of HJ? Why do specific mutations in BRCA1 protein lead to impaired DNA damage repair? Do those amino acids play any role in BRCA1-HJ interactions? Using single-molecule Fluorescence Correlation Spectroscopy, we showed that BRCA1 prefers an open-planar conformation of HJ and has a 10-fold lesser affinity for stacked HJ. The preference for an open-planar structure is independent of the nucleotide sequence at the branch point. Molecular docking and all-atom molecular dynamics simulation unraveled that primarily charged and polar residues in the DNA binding region from exon 11 of BRCA1 participated in the interaction. Most of those amino acids are places for missense changes. Further computational studies revealed that mutating these residues disrupted the interaction.
abstract_zh: BRCA1是一种复杂的肿瘤抑制蛋白，参与多种关键细胞过程，例如DNA双链断裂修复、细胞周期检查点等。BRCA1缺失的细胞表现出同源重组（HR）减少，并促进易错的非同源末端连接进行DNA损伤修复。Holliday连接（HJ）是通过HR进行DNA损伤修复机制的重要中间体。BRCA1蛋白对HJ具有高亲和力，并招募多种蛋白质至DNA损伤位点。然而，关于BRCA1蛋白与HJ结合的问题仍存疑问。BRCA1蛋白是否对HJ的异构体表现出偏好？BRCA1蛋白中的特定突变为何导致DNA损伤修复受损？这些氨基酸是否在BRCA1-HJ相互作用中发挥作用？利用单分子荧光相关光谱，我们表明BRCA1偏好HJ的开放平面构象，并且对堆叠HJ的亲和力低10倍。对开放平面结构的偏好与分支点处的核苷酸序列无关。分子对接和全原子分子动力学模拟揭示，BRCA1外显子11中DNA结合区域的主要带电和极性残基参与了相互作用。这些氨基酸中的大多数是错义变化的位点。进一步的计算研究表明，突变这些残基会破坏相互作用。
